## Nov 08 2026, Phase E7: Solana A+ touch review (chain receipt registry, receipt stamp, bundled memo evidence)

| Low | src/data/receipts.test.ts:121 to 128 | The model card digest test early returns when the receipt is absent (lines 123 to 126), so a parseChainReceipt regression that drops the receipt would skip the digest pin silently; the registry test at lines 141 to 154 only catches files missing from disk, not parse failures masquerading as absence | Assert the modelcard receipt exists (fail instead of returning), or pin loadBundledReceipts length to the on disk file count so a dropped receipt cannot hide |

send timestamps noted (root confirmed 2026-11-07T02:47:12Z slot 519514224, modelcard 2026-11-08T06:43:55Z slot 519934572, fingerprint 2026-11-08T06:44:11Z slot 519934638, both later sends before the Sun 12 PM submit hard stop and pinning bytes that still match the current artifacts).

END
